title: StoreFi
tagline: A decentralized Auction provider, where potential buyers place competitive bids for Filecoin storage.
description:
StoreFi allows users to list their Filecoin Storage in an decentralized Auction, and allows other people to bid for the Storage.
This project allows two types of users: Buyers and Sellers.
Sellers create their Auctions, Buyers bid.
After the bid time is over, the highest bidder and the seller sign a deal. This is done via a smart contract function.
Sellers determine the minimum bid price and time.
how_its_made:
The StoreFi team consists of 4 people.
Along the way, we faced a lot of challenges but we are very proud at the end result in this short period of time.
We created a fully sustainable Proxy system for creating Smart Contract Auction on the FEVM Wallaby test net.
A lot of technologies were used, ensuring the security and implementation of Smart contract logic.
We used React, Web3.js and Moralis for the front-end.
